meta.name: alfworld-receptacle-closer
meta.description: Closes an open receptacle to maintain environment tidiness after inspection. Use when you have finished searching a container (drawer, cabinet, fridge) and no longer need it open. Takes a receptacle identifier as input and outputs confirmation that the receptacle is closed, preventing clutter during multi-step search tasks.

copy.tagline: 关闭已检查过的容器，保持环境整洁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在模拟环境中搜索物品后需要关闭打开的抽屉或柜门
copy.tagline_en: Close inspected containers to keep environment tidy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to close drawers or cabinets after searching in a simulated environment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在检查完抽屉、柜子、冰箱等容器后，会自动将它们关闭，保持环境整洁，并输出关闭确认信息。
howto.when: 当 Claude 刚搜索完一个打开的容器（如抽屉、柜子、冰箱），并且确定不再需要它打开时，会立即触发关闭操作。

say.text: 检查完抽屉后请把它关上。
say.note: Claude 会关闭指定的抽屉。

say.text: 搜索完冰箱后记得关门。
say.note: Claude 会执行关闭冰箱的动作。

say.text: 把柜子关好再继续搜索。
say.note: Claude 会关闭柜子并确认。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically close containers (drawers, cabinets, fridge) after inspecting them, maintaining tidiness. Outputs a confirmation action.
howto.when_en: Triggered immediately after Claude finishes searching an open receptacle (e.g., drawer, cabinet, fridge) and no longer needs it open.

say_en.text: Close the drawer after checking it.
say_en.note: Claude will close the specified drawer.

say_en.text: Remember to close the fridge after searching.
say_en.note: Claude will perform closing the fridge.
Claude will close the cabinet and confirm.
